title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Million Pesos and Two Hundred Thousand Pesos, Respectively, for Relief and Aid to Fire Victims in the Cities of Cavite and Butuan
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Million Pesos and Two Hundred Thousand Pesos, Respectively, for Relief and Aid to Fire Victims in the Cities of Cavite and Butuan

text.en:
There are appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sums of one million pesos for relief and aid to Filipino fire victims in the City of Cavite, and two hundred thousand pesos for Butuan City.
The distribution of the relief and aid shall be made by the Red Cross.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 25, 1960.
